summary: Backend-only offline verification of Pix recipients reconcile fix. All 72 tests passed (+9 subtests) across test_pix_recipients_reconcile.py (4), test_p5_pix_checkout_integration.py (1), test_pix_service.py, test_pix_readiness.py, test_p5_rules.py with STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_offline and Stripe mocked. Preview GET /api/admin/pix/recipients/c-d42b89cc4c as admin returned 200 with 'sem pix_stripe_account_id' for both partner and influencer. No Stripe calls, no production, no /api/diretor calls.

minor.issue: Not atomic: if partner is stamped and the influencer retrieve/update then raises 502, response is 502 and partner's success is not reported (still audited). Re-running is safe (idempotent -> 'já associado').

No check for partner and influencer sharing the same account id (diagnostic flags it, reconcile does not); second role would then hit 'conflito', so no re-bind, but an explicit early guard would be clearer.
Conflict message includes the other owner's internal id (admin-only, low risk).

action_items: Optional: add a test for country != BR -> 'conta inesperada' with no accounts.update (code path is correct by review but untested)
Optional: guard same-account partner/influencer in reconcile
critical_code_review_comments: recipients_reconcile: accounts.update only reached after (a) metadata has no partner_id/influencer_id, (b) country == BR and info.id == stored acct, (c) email or name evidence matches; empty record name cannot match since '' is removed from the names set. CONFIRMED.
audit() awaited after successful update. CONFIRMED. Only accounts.retrieve/accounts.update are called; no accounts.create, bank, or commission changes. CONFIRMED.
recipients_diagnostic: read-only (only accounts.retrieve), masks account ids to last 6 chars, returns evidencia_independente. CONFIRMED.
Name evidence is weaker than email (Stripe business name can be self-declared), but it's acceptable since the account id must already match the stored one.
